text:
leo: Quick nightcap game: one song + one short story that pair for a calm but slightly strange bedtime. My pick: 'Waltz for Koop' (instrumental) + 'The Lottery' by Shirley Jackson. weird lullaby.
maya: Nice. I'll go with 'Nightfall' (Nils Frahm) + 'The Paper Menagerie' by Ken Liu. soft and heartbreaking.
harper: 'Into Dust' (Mazzy Star) + 'A Good Man Is Hard to Find' by Flannery O'Connor. melancholic with edge.
meme-bot: Sleep safety tip: put your phone away after reading. :zzz:
leo: If you like someone else's combo, drop a "+1".
maya: +1 @leo (Waltz for Koop + Lottery)
harper: +1 @maya (Nils Frahm + Paper Menagerie)
leo: Cool — thanks all. Maybe next week: one movie + one poem?
